about: Reviewed, pinned copies installed by `narvai.mjs install` from third-party/ (no network at install time). Updating: clone the source at a new commit, read what changed (scripts, network calls, hooks), copy only the listed skills over third-party/skills, re-apply the local changes, update the commit here.

localChanges: web-design-guidelines reads guidelines.md (vercel-labs/web-interface-guidelines @ 434b7f9) instead of fetching it at run time
differential-review dispatches adversarial-modeler by its plain name (no plugin namespace)

manual: git clone https://github.com/Egonex-AI/Understand-Anything ~/.understand-anything-plugin && git -C ~/.understand-anything-plugin checkout 182c7fb, then build its core (see KURULUM-NOTU.txt there); its own hooks are not installed

localChanges: SKILL.md and reference/ only: no launcher, detector engine, hooks or plugin agents; a 'Local install' block at the top points it at the project profile

plugins.about: Claude Code plugins narvai routes to (agent-skills from addy-agent-skills, LSP from claude-plugins-official); install with /plugin, not vendored.

tools.about: Checked by `narvai.mjs doctor`; installed by hand when a skill needs them (Heavy Mode tools ask first).
